title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 058 ]

blocks.text: In educating students for adult work and adult life, American schools try, above all, to be practical. American education has been greatly influenced by the writings of a famous 20th-century philosopher named John Dewey. Dewey believed that the only worthwhile knowledge was knowledge thatcan be used in a real life . He convinced educators that it was pointless to make students memorize useless facts that they would quickly forget. Rather, schools should teach thinking processes and skills that affect how people live and work.

readingSentences.english: In educating students for adult work and adult life, American schools try, above all, to be practical.
readingSentences.korean: 성인 일과 삶에 대해 학생을 교육시킬 때 미국 학교는 무엇보다도 실용적이도록 시도한다.

readingSentences.english: American education has been greatly influenced by the writings of a famous 20th-century philosopher named John Dewey.
readingSentences.korean: 미국 교육은 상당히 John Dewey 라고 불리는 유명한 20세기 철학자의 글에서 크게 영향을 받아왔다.

readingSentences.english: Dewey believed that the only worthwhile knowledge was knowledge thatcan be used in a real life .
readingSentences.korean: John Dewey는 유일한 가치 있는 지식은 실생활에 사용될 수 있는 지식이라고 믿었다.

readingSentences.english: He convinced educators that it was pointless to make students memorize useless facts that they would quickly forget.
readingSentences.korean: 그는 교육자들에게 학생들이 쓸모없는 사실을 암기 하게 하는 것은 무의미하다고 확신시켰다.

readingSentences.english: Rather, schools should teach thinking processes and skills that affect how people live and work.
readingSentences.korean: 차라리 학교는 사람들이 생활하고 일하는 방법에 영향을 끼치는 사고 과정과 기술을 가르쳐야만 한다.
